newsitem.title: UK: UK National Audit Office report due at 1430 GMT.
newsitem.headline: UK National Audit Office report due at 1430 GMT.

text.p: The UK Treasury will be publishing the National Audit Office's report at 1430 GMT on the assumptions underlying the government finances, a Treasury spokesman said.

One of Gordon Brown's first moves after becoming Chancellor of the Exchequer, when the Labour party won the May 1 election, was to commission a report from the audit office on the assumptions underlying the Treasury's forecasts.
There are fears in financial markets that the report will show there is a hole in the public finances. --Cheryl Juckes +44 171 542 5109
